title: Channel breakout, 55 days in and 20 out
author: arhancanli
rationale: A new high over a long window can mark the start of a trend. The shorter exit window gets out before all of a move is given back. The rule was popularised by trend followers in commodity markets.
risks: Many small losses from false breakouts between occasional large gains. It does poorly in choppy markets with no sustained moves.
references: Donchian (1960), High Finance in Copper, Financial Analysts Journal
